https://www.prc.gov.ph/article/april-202.evidence: Resolutions 2138 (2025), pages 1-2, and 2163 (2026), page 2, visually reviewed. The April release explicitly names Doha, Dubai and NCR; these are the three preceding scheduled sittings, with NCR target release April 28 matching publication. Release month is not the examination month.

https://www.prc.gov.ph/article/september.evidence: Resolution 2163 (2026), page 2: Cagayan de Oro August 3-5, target release September 10. Actual publication September 14 names Cagayan de Oro. September 21-23 is Davao with December target release and is excluded.

https://www.prc.gov.ph/article/august-20.evidence: Resolution 2163 (2026), page 3 groups eleven preceding regional sittings under August 12 target release; actual August 13 release names those locations. Resolution 2158 confirms San Fernando City, Pampanga April 14-16; resolutions 2192 and 2221 amend dates. This is a reviewed association using the release grouping and locations, not a claim that all examinations occurred in August.
unresolvedSittings: Davao: August release names this location, but its only dated 2026 schedule entry is September 1-3 with December target release. Earlier evaluation dates remain unconfirmed.

https://www.prc.gov.ph/index.php/article.evidence: Resolution 2163 (2026), page 2 groups the preceding domestic sittings under October 23 release. Resolution 2189 adds Singapore July 23-24 and resolution 2251 adds NCR October 8, 9 and 12; both locations occur in the October 23 publication. Cancelled Cebu August 13-14 and future Davao November 19-20 are excluded.
